note: 'a size size smaller' holds the grading word 'smaller' as a dependent of the measure nominal headed by 'size', so it describes the measure instead of saying how the caps should be
'one higher contour levels' holds 'higher' as a dependent of 'levels', so the grading word becomes part of the description by which the levels are found
'contour levels one higher' holds 'higher' as a dependent of the measure nominal 'one', so it describes the measure instead of saying how the levels should be
'the chart polar' writes 'polar' as a nominal of its own tied to 'the chart', so the word that says how the chart should be becomes part of what identifies it
'chart size biigger' puts 'biigger' in the head of the nominal, so 'chart size' becomes the description of the grading word
'also do the y axis logarithmic' writes 'logarithmic' as the verb of a clause with 'the y axis' as its subject, though it is no verb here
'while' is written as the marker of a relation that starts at the last clause of the message instead of at the clause of 'set the y axis logarithmic', whose rider it is
'can you make the x axis lineaar?' is written as a declarative clause, though the words make it a question
'the x axis linnear' puts 'linnear' in the head of the nominal, so 'the x axis' becomes its description instead of the thing to set
'make the x axis liear' writes 'liear' as the verb of a nonfinite clause with 'the x axis' as its subject, though it is no verb here
'grid lines bihind the data' writes 'bihind' as the verb of a declarative clause with 'grid lines' as its subject, though it is the linking word of a relation
